title: Eligibility
description: Check the published requirements for your chosen program.
question: What are the eligibility requirements for Commerce?
excerpt:
**Note: Any misstatement of information will automatically cancel admission without any claim on the Commecs College**

*   65% and above marks in SSC/equivalent examination for Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical and Computer Sciences disciplines
*   60% and above marks in SSC/equivalent examination for Commerce discipline.
*   Candidates with Cambridge background are required to clear 8 papers with 4 compulsory papers (Urdu, English, Pakistan Studies and Islamiat) and one Mathematics paper from optional subjects
*   Candidates with SSC General Group are NOT eligible to apply for admission in Science Group (Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical)
*   Candidates who have studied Computer Studies in lieu of Biology in SSC or its equivalent examination are NOT eligible to apply for admission in Pre-Medical Group
*   Candidates who have not studied Biology/Computer Science in O’ Level Examination are not eligible to apply for admission in Science (Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical groups)

*   Applicants must not be above 18 years of age as on August 1st, in the year of application. However, those more than 18 years of age but less than 19 can be admitted subject to approval of the Chairman-CET.
*   Relaxation up to 1.5 years is given to Huffaz-e-Quran (candidates are required to show their “Sanad”)

Applicants are required to register themselves online on our website. 

*   Photocopy of marks sheet / transcript / promotion certificate obtained in SSC-I/O’ Level Examinations
*   Photocopy of Birth Certificate / B. Form
*   Photocopy of SSC-II Admit Card/Statement of Entry
*   Two passport size photographs
*   Admission Processing Fee of Rs. 1,000/=
*   Hifz Sanad (For Huffaz Only)

title: About
description: Get to know Commecs and its academic programs.
question: What programs do you offer?
excerpt:
To promote excellence in education for seekers of knowledge by giving them two bequests – the first is Roots, the second is Wings.

*   To bring a quantum change in the quality of education

*   To equip the students with practical knowledge for meeting the challenges of the new millennium with confidence, grace, and competence

*   To prepare future leaders of business and society, and to inculcate in them a sense of pride in performance, as well as, a high level of ethical and moral standards

Commecs College was established in 1993 under the auspices of the Commecs Educational Trust (CET), a not-for-profit organization founded in 1988 by COMMECS, the alumni association of the Government College of Commerce & Economics. Since its inception, the College has embodied the vision of its founders to promote quality education and institutional excellence. The trustees were concerned at the dearth of good educational institutions in the fields of business, science and technology. As its first step, CET established the Commecs Institute of Business Education (CIBE) in 1993 (Now known as “Commecs College”). Three programmes were offered:

*   Intermediate Commerce (Affiliated with Board of Intermediate Education Karachi – BIEK)
*   B.B.A (Affiliated with IBA Karachi)
*   B. Com. (Affiliated with IBA Karachi)

The educational standards were set to conform to the vision of the founders. Encouraged and motivated by the initial success, CET launched the science discipline in the year 2003 and changed the name of the institute to Commecs Institute of Business and Emerging Sciences (CIBES).

In May 2007, CIBES received a charter from Government of Sindh and recognition from Higher Education Commission (HEC) as a Degree Awarding Institute and started its own BBA and MBA degree programmes, at 40-B PECHS. With this status IBA-affiliated programmes were discontinued.

Commecs College at present is running an Intermediate Programme in affiliation with the Board of Intermediate Education Karachi (BIEK), offering the disciplines of:

*   Commerce
*   Pre-Engineering
*   Pre-Medical
*   Computer Science

*   Humanities

title: Fee Payment Policy
description: Read payment rules and confirm the applicable session.
question: What is the fee payment policy?
excerpt:
*   Accounts department will issue fee vouchers by 5th of each month.
*   Due date to pay the fee will be 10 days.
*   A penalty of Rs.1,000/- will be imposed, if the fee is not paid within due date.
*   Vouchers will be valid till last day of each month.
*   If the fee is not paid for consecutive two months, the admission will be cancelled.
*   Students may, however, be readmitted on receiving the written request from the parents, subject to approval by the management and payment of readmission fee of Rs.10,000/- and the outstanding fee. The application for readmission will be entertained if submitted within 7 days of cancellation of admission.
